metadata.scope: LM-series rod carriages, MGN rail adapter plates, V-slot wheel plates, smooth-rod end holders.

material_suggestions.use_case: machined carriage plates for CNC and robotics
material_suggestions.notes: Rigid; bore rod holes to H7 for tight LM bearing fit.
Lower creep than PLA; add metal rod inserts for bore accuracy.
Acceptable for light-duty; bore may wear over time.

standards_used.name: LM-series linear bearing standard
standards_used.note: LM8UU: bore 8 mm, OD 15 mm, length 24 mm. Housing bore = OD + 0.0/+0.05 mm transition fit.

standards_used.name: MGN12H carriage footprint
standards_used.note: MGN12H: 33×27 mm, 4×M3 holes on 20×20 mm pattern.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: Dual LM8UU rod carriage

rod_spacing.note: must match printer or CNC frame

main_features: two parallel rod bores along travel axis
mounting holes on top face for payload
optional nut pocket for lead screw if combined with actuator
design_rules: Rod bores: horizontal along X using rotate([0,90,0]), centered at y=±rod_spacing/2, z = -car_h/2 + bottom_wall + lm_od/2.
Bore diameter = lm_od + 0.1 mm (15.1 mm for LM8UU) for transition/press fit.

Bottom relief: translate([0,0,-car_h/2 + bottom_wall + relief_depth/2]) cube([...relief_depth], center=true). NEVER use -car_h/2 + wall_thickness/2 — that centers the cube at the bottom face and removes the entire bottom wall.

Mounting holes: center the cylinder at z=0 so it passes through the full carriage height: translate([x,y,0]) cylinder(h=car_h+2, d=mount_d, center=true). Do NOT translate to carriage_height/2+0.1 with center=true — that creates half-depth holes only.

Hex nut trap and coaxial bolt must be the SAME bolt family. M3: hex_nut_af=5.5 mm, bolt_d=3.4 mm. M4: hex_nut_af=7.0 mm, bolt_d=4.5 mm. M6: hex_nut_af=10 mm, bolt_d=6.5 mm. NEVER pair a 3.4 mm bolt hole (M3) with a 10 mm nut pocket (M6).
Hex nut pocket depth = nut_height + 0.2 mm; diameter = hex_nut_af/cos(30) + 0.2 mm with $fn=6.
Carriage length = lm_length + 2*end_wall; width = rod_spacing + lm_od + 2*side_wall.
validation_criteria: two rod bores use rotate([0,90,0]) with bore = lm_od+0.1
bottom relief translate z = -car_h/2 + bottom_wall + relief_depth/2 — NOT -car_h/2 + wall_thickness/2
mounting holes centered at z=0 (through-holes), not at z=car_h/2
hex nut pocket diameter and coaxial bolt clearance hole match the same bolt size
failure_modes: bottom relief translate([0,0,-car_h/2 + wall_thickness/2]) with h=wall_thickness removes the entire bottom wall
mounting holes at translate([..., carriage_height/2+0.1]) with center=true — holes are only half-depth
hex_nut_d = 10 mm (M6) with hex_bolt_d = 3.4 mm (M3) — bolt will rattle loose in nut
single rod bore instead of two

constraint_checks.message: Dual-rod carriage needs two parallel rod bores.
